_note: Engine settings. Clinician and dietitian sign-off is required before any value is used for care.

phosphorus_absorption._note: Fractions absorbed by phosphorus source. Two published sets are kept; the engine reports the range across both.

polderman_2026.citation: Polderman N, Shaw V et al. Clin Kidney J 2026;19(4):sfag046

potassium_leaching._note: No leaching factor is approved. Entries marked as leached are reported unleached (the conservative value) until a dietitian approves a factor here.

fluid_densities_note: Grams for a fluid entered in mL use the food's density_g_per_ml (milk 1.03; others 1.0).
